workflow_lessons: Raw parallel swarms were useful for discovery but became server-rate-limit-bound and produced wasted agent runs when too many workflows ran concurrently.
The safer scalable pattern is one large workflow at a time: page-local discovery, independent verification, deterministic patch application, and a compile gate.
OCR and source crops are witness/localization layers only; source-page images and compiled TeX diffs remain the audit controls.

Support ZIPs can become stale within hours during an active workpass, so public records should label them as snapshots unless deliberately repackaged at a stable milestone. This packet is now explicitly a p90 snapshot relative to the later p93 live status reconciliation.
Public archive labels must distinguish method/support packets, source-witnessed working drafts, source-audit candidates, and certified/critical editions.

The 2026-06-25 pages 1-90 manual certification pass captured in this ZIP shows the core archive lesson: high-precision agent findings still miss repeated notation classes, source-typo traps, underlines, and parallel occurrences; public records must separate repair evidence from page-local certification.

The later live post-snapshot hand pass advanced to pp.1-93 in the separate SGA status reconciliation and strengthened the same lesson: agent precision can be high, but recall is incomplete across repeated twist signs, underlined Hom/Ext/H conventions, source-typo traps, and parallel references; page-local certification remains the controlling standard.
caveats: This package does not certify SGA5 and should not be attached to the SGA author record as a reader replacement.

The workflow ZIP contains the p90 CERT_LOG and AGENT_SCORECARD snapshot, with p91 next inside that snapshot; the separate live status reconciliation has since advanced to pp.1-93/p94 next, so future workflow refreshes should capture later pages before claiming them inside the workflow artifact.

The associated SGA5 workpass remains incomplete/errorful globally, with English synchronization open and remaining page ranges requiring source comparison; only the current CERT_LOG page-local range should be treated as certified.
The package intentionally excludes bulky source crops, page renders, and the full workpass TeX/PDF.
